target_customer: Aircraft maintenance and engineering teams (base, line, engines, components) at operators; at YC time, companies wanting internal AI apps
problem: Aircraft maintenance engineers and planners spend hours per finding on work across M&E systems, ERPs and OEM portals; the company says resolution drops from 2 to 6 hours to 15 minutes.
business_model: Enterprise software for MRO operators; pricing not found

founders.name: Celia Manzano
founders.background_notes: Cloud architect at Salesforce; built torque vectoring ECU for UPM Racing (Formula SAE) per YC page

founders.name: Javier Sanchez
education: UPM, computer science and telecommunications engineering (BS)
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer at Stack AI; led LiDAR perception software for UPM Racing per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must operate across fragmented legacy M&E systems, ERPs and OEM portals with safety critical documentation and human sign-off.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration into maintenance records and a joined operational model (Holocron) create lock in once deployed; a small team has no named customers yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent platforms exist; an Aviation Week piece says MRO AI is consolidating. No acquisition of Rebolt found.

market_need_then: Aviation maintenance labor shortages and heavy documentation; evidence here is the company's own claims and MRO events, no independent spend data.

branding.domain_note: Uses rebolt.ai; the name collides with other companies called Rebolt (a Chicago company shows up in databases)

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident, plain: Agents do the work. Engineers review and sign.

branding.community_and_virality: Appears on the TechCrunch W25 Demo Day list of startups to watch per a search result; no community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is generic and shared by others, and databases confuse it with other companies; the Star Wars style Holocron name is a minor asset.

pivots.from: AI powered company OS for building internal apps and agents
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC launch post and aggregator profiles describe the company OS while the YC page and site now describe aviation

outcome_analysis: Rebolt entered Winter 2025 as a company OS for internal AI apps and now positions itself on aircraft maintenance, a narrower regulated market with clear spend. No verified funding, named customers or exit is public, so the outcome is open; the early pivot and thin evidence are the main uncertainties.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators disagree (Neuronfeed and Standout say about 4M; PitchBook lists a 3M seed on 2025-05-07 and 4.25M total; VCBacked says 500K). No company or press source, so none recorded. Some listings describe a restaurant AI company or a Chicago company with the same name, so identity is uncertain. No dated competitor sources near the batch found. Pivot date unknown.
